samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_diveven">
    <description>Even Number Frequency Divider</description>
    
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input Clock Signal</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset Signal</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Divided Clock Output Signal</output>
        
    </ports>
    
    
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NUM_DIV">Number of divisions for the frequency divider.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt">Counter for the frequency divider.</reg>
        <wire id="enable">Enable signal for the frequency divider.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    
    
    
    <implementation> 
       <assign enable = NUM_DIV[0]==0 && cnt == NUM_DIV[3:1]-1'd1 ? 1 : 0;
       always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)begin
           if(!rst_n)begin
               cnt <= 0;
               clk_div <= 0;
           end else begin
           	if(enable)begin
                    cnt<=0;
                  	clk_div<=~clk_div;
                end else begin
                    cnt<=cnt+1'd1;
                end
           	end
        end
   
       
    </implementation>
    
    <task>
        
    </task>
    
</module>
